parameters.name: CsrId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the CSR. The CsrId is generated when you upload the CSR. You can obtain this value by querying the CSR list. For more information, see [ListCsr](~~2709717~~).

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The certificate private key content in PEM format. This private key must match the public key cryptography contained in the CSR referenced by CsrId. Otherwise, the API returns the NotMatch.CsrAndPrivateKey error.
